description:
The expressions of the different rules follow the syntax of the SQL OLAP database 
        management system called DuckDB. For more information, visit https://duckdb.org/docs/sql/introduction. 
        Keep in mind that you only have to declare as a rule the statement that would follow a WHERE clause. 
        e.g.,  Select * from people WHERE {expression}
        expression = age >= 18

rules.expression: Sexo IN ('H', 'M') or Sexo IS NULL
rules.name: Sexo

rules.expression: Pais_Nac BETWEEN 100 AND 600 or Pais_Nac IS NULL
rules.name: Pais_Nac

rules.expression: TSI IN ('TSI001', 'TSI002_01', 'TSI002_02', 'TSI003', 'TSI004', 'TSI005', 'TSI005_03', 'TSI006', 'Otros') or TSI IS NULL
rules.name: TSI

rules.expression: F_Baja BETWEEN 2012 AND 2022 or F_Baja IS NULL
rules.name: F_Baja

rules.expression: F_Exitus BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' OR F_Exitus IS NULL
rules.name: F_Exitus

rules.expression: F_Dependencia BETWEEN 1920 AND 2022 OR F_Dependencia IS NULL
rules.name: F_Dependencia

rules.expression: F_Institucionalizacion BETWEEN 1920 AND 2022 OR F_Institucionalizacion IS NULL
rules.name: F_Institucionalizacion

rules.expression: F_CronDom BETWEEN 2000 AND 2022 OR F_CronDom IS NULL
rules.name: F_CronDom
